summary: Frontend-only E2E testing of BikerLink landing page. All 16 requested features pass. All declared data-testids are present and functional. Language toggle (IT/EN), FAQ accordion, Pic! Contest carousel, smooth-scroll anchor navigation, SOS pulse animation, and mobile hamburger menu all working. Zero console errors on load/interaction.

passing: Page loads at / with 0 console errors and 0 page errors
Navbar renders sticky with logo, lang toggle (IT/EN), Scarica App CTA, mobile menu button
Hero shows 'CONNETTI LA TUA PASSIONE.' title, subtitle (138 chars IT, 130 chars EN), App Store + Google Play CTAs, and 4 stats (18 Tipi di Match, 100KM Raggio SOS, 50+ Moto Club, 24/7 Real-Time)
User Types section renders 3 cards (BIKER, ZAVORRINE, COPPIE)
Features section renders all 8 feature cards (feature-card-0..7)
Safety section renders 3 items; SOS item-0 contains pulse animation element
Race Mode shows 4 metrics: 287 KM/H, 3.4 SEC, 52° ANGLE, 428 KM
Pic! Contest carousel renders 5 photos and prev/next buttons clickable without error
FAQ accordion: clicking faq-trigger-0 toggles aria-expanded from false→true
Footer renders with app store + google play buttons
Language toggle: EN switches hero title to 'CONNECT YOUR PASSION.' and nav-link-features label to 'Features'; IT restores 'CONNETTI LA TUA PASSIONE.'
Smooth-scroll: clicking nav-link-faq scrolls window to y=7147 (~FAQ position)
Mobile (390x844): mobile-menu-button visible; clicking opens menu showing all 5 links + IT/EN + Scarica App (verified via screenshot)
minor_observations: Navbar nav-link testids derive from href (e.g. href='#users' → nav-link-users), so the spec-mentioned 'nav-link-user-types' does NOT exist. Actual testid is 'nav-link-users'. The anchor #users correctly matches the UserTypes section id. Not a bug — just a naming mismatch between test spec and implementation. Suggest aligning section data-testid 'user-types-section' with anchor 'users' or updating spec.
Mobile menu uses its own testid prefix 'mobile-nav-link-*' (separate from desktop 'nav-link-*'). This is intentional and acceptable; review_request only mentions desktop testids.
Hero CTAs (App Store / Google Play) currently link to href='#' placeholders — expected for a marketing landing page without published app links.

action_items: OPTIONAL: Standardize naming between Navbar href '#users' and section data-testid 'user-types-section' (either rename anchor to '#user-types' or testid to 'users-section') so testids and nav links share a consistent token. Pure cosmetic — does not block any functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: Clean separation of concerns: each section is its own component under /app/frontend/src/sections; LanguageContext + translations.js keep i18n centralized.
All interactive elements have data-testid attributes — excellent testability.
No backend changes — pure static landing page as expected.
test_credentials: N/A — no auth on landing page
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is fully functional and verified. All sections, i18n toggle, FAQ accordion, carousel, smooth-scroll, and mobile menu all working. Only minor observation: the spec referenced nav-link-user-types but actual testid is nav-link-users because Navbar derives testid from href='#users'. Confirmed working visually and via locator.
